article.title: Node.js 26.13.0 'Lithium' Moves Node.js 26.x Into LTS Through April 2029, While the Node.js 27.0.0-alpha.0 Pre-Release Lists V8 15.6 and OpenSSL 3 as a Minimum
article.summary: Node.js 26.13.0 marks 26.x as LTS with updates through the end of April 2029 and no other changes from 26.12.1; the 27.0.0-alpha.0 pre-release lists V8 15.6.75.13 and breaking changes.
